scientific_integrity: The only asserted homotopy type is the ordinary matching complex of the listed twelve-vertex graph. Reproducible standalone code and actual outputs are embedded; computer experiments do not assert an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation for the specified graph; no general family theorem, no equivariant homotopy splitting or minimal-torsion assertion. Mathematical proof uses exhaustive acyclic discrete Morse matching, signed integer degree matrix, and standard homotopy classification. Literature coverage is not a guarantee of global novelty; independent mathematical audit is not yet performed.
title: Three-torsion and the integral homotopy type of the Chvátal graph matching complex
